# RetryKit complete context

> `@rohan9024/retrykit` is a zero-runtime-dependency TypeScript reliability layer for AI applications.

## Installation

```bash
npm i @rohan9024/retrykit
npx skills add rohan9024/retrykit --skill retrykit
```

The first command installs runtime code. The second installs coding-agent instructions.

## Core API

Use `retry(fn, options)` for promises, `retryFetch()` for HTTP, `CircuitBreaker` for outages, `ProviderCoordinator` for bounded concurrency, `fallbackChain` for explicit fallback, and `retryStream` for streaming. A stream may resume only with explicit `getCheckpoint`; otherwise a post-emission failure is rejected to prevent duplicate output.

## Auto integration

`wrapAI(client, options?)` recursively proxies nested resources including `chat.completions.create` and `messages.create`. It can select keys from `OPENAI_API_KEYS`, numbered `OPENAI_API_KEY_1` variables, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEYS`, and `GEMINI_API_KEYS`. When RetryKit owns retries, nested SDK `maxRetries` values are normalized to zero for calls.

## Middleware and MCP

`retryMiddleware()` implements structural `transformParams`, `wrapGenerate`, and `wrapStream` without importing the Vercel AI SDK. `withMcpRetry()` retries exact safe MCP methods or explicitly allowlisted tool names. `tools/call` is not safe by default. MCP results with `isError: true` are retried only for idempotent operations.

## Safety

Never replay unsafe mutations without application-level idempotency. Do not log credentials. Do not stack independent retry loops. Local coordinator and key-pool state is process-local. Estimated pricing is not exact billing.
